answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 8236 Country: India Title: In our masjid mouzan says ikamat only one time like allahu akbar asahaduanlailahaillah like onetime not to otimes is it correct? Question: In our masjid mouzan says ikamat only one time like allahu akbar asahaduanlailahaillah like onetime not to otimes is it correct? Answer ID: 8236 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1886/293=TB/1429) It is the same according to Imam Shafei, but according to Hanfi Fiqh it is better to say two times. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
